skill.name: longbridge-portfolio
skill.description: Use Longbridge CLI or MCP workflows to review account assets, positions, P&L, statements, margin data, orders, recurring investments, and portfolio risk frameworks. Supports read-only analysis and requires explicit confirmation before order or DCA changes.
skill.summary: Analyze Longbridge brokerage data, portfolio risk, orders, statements, and confirmed recurring investment workflows.
skill.author: longbridge

security_audit.summary: All static backtick and system reconnaissance alerts were reviewed against Markdown context and judged false positives. The backtick alerts are inline code, CLI help excerpts, or code fences, not Ruby or shell backtick execution. Two semantic risks remain: the skill can access sensitive brokerage data and can perform confirmed order or DCA mutations that affect real money.

remediation.issue: Order and DCA workflows can change brokerage account state and commit real money.
remediation.suggestion: Keep a mandatory two-turn preview and explicit confirmation flow for every mutation, with no defaults for amount, currency, schedule, or symbol.

remediation.issue: Authenticated commands can expose sensitive assets, positions, statements, cash flows, and bank card metadata.
remediation.suggestion: Document required Longbridge scopes, minimize displayed account identifiers, and prefer read-only commands unless the user asks for a mutation.

remediation.issue: Portfolio, tax, and risk outputs may be mistaken for professional advice.
remediation.suggestion: Preserve clear non-advice disclaimers, identify data sources, and state tax jurisdiction limits before action-oriented recommendations.

semantic_findings.title: Brokerage Mutations Can Commit Real Money
semantic_findings.description: The skill includes order and DCA workflows that can buy, sell, cancel, replace, or schedule brokerage transactions. The files include preview and explicit confirmation safeguards, but misuse could still affect real funds.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited text directly states that order and DCA commands mutate brokerage account state and that DCA commits real money on a schedule. The risk is intended functionality, not hidden malicious behavior.

content.value_statement: Brokerage account data is hard to review across assets, P&L, orders, and statements. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Longbridge workflows for analysis and confirmed trading actions.
actual_capabilities: Reviews Longbridge assets, cash, buying power, margin details, and account risk fields.
Retrieves stock positions, fund positions, P&L, cash flow, statements, and bank card information.
Checks margin ratios and estimated maximum buy or sell quantity for a symbol.
Guides portfolio diagnosis, rebalancing, allocation, risk, attribution, and tax-loss harvesting workflows.
Manages order and DCA workflows with preview and explicit confirmation before mutations.
limitations: Requires Longbridge CLI or MCP access and the correct account permissions.
Mutating order and DCA actions can affect real money and require explicit confirmation.
Analysis depends on available account data, market history, and CLI output quality.
Tax-loss harvesting guidance focuses on US-listed securities and is not tax advice.

use_cases.title: Review Portfolio Health
use_cases.description: Summarize assets, positions, P&L, concentration, margin exposure, and current account risk from Longbridge data.

use_cases.title: Prepare Trading Actions
use_cases.description: Estimate buying power, preview order changes, and require explicit confirmation before any buy, sell, cancel, or replace action.

use_cases.title: Plan Allocation And Taxes
use_cases.description: Evaluate rebalancing, risk-return tradeoffs, performance attribution, and tax-loss harvesting candidates before manual execution.

prompt_templates.title: Check Account Overview
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Longbridge to summarize my account assets, cash, buying power, and current positions. Keep the result concise and note any missing permissions.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Portfolio Risk
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Longbridge portfolio for concentration, sector exposure, margin risk, and recent P&L. Explain the top risks and likely causes.

prompt_templates.title: Create Rebalance Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my current Longbridge holdings against these target weights: [add targets]. Produce a read-only rebalance plan with estimated trade sizes and risks.

prompt_templates.title: Preview DCA Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a preview for creating or updating this DCA plan: [symbol, amount, currency, frequency, dates]. Do not execute until I explicitly confirm.

output_examples.input: Show my assets and current positions.
output: Account summary with total assets, cash, buying power, and margin status.
Positions table grouped by market, with quantity, cost basis, and available shares.
Short notes about missing permissions or stale data.

output_examples.input: Can I buy 100 shares of TSLA.US at 250 USD?
output: Estimated cash and margin buying capacity for the requested symbol and price.
A risk note explaining that buying power is not investment advice.
No order is submitted unless the user asks for a preview and confirms.

output_examples.input: Create a monthly DCA plan for AAPL.US at 500 USD.
output: A preview listing symbol, amount, currency, frequency, start date, and end rule.
A clear warning that the plan will place recurring buy orders.
A request for explicit confirmation before execution.

best_practices: Start with read-only account and position checks before discussing trading actions.
Provide exact amounts, currency, symbol, schedule, and date range for order or DCA previews.
Review non-advice disclaimers and confirm the data source before making financial decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the assistant to place or change orders without a separate preview step.
Do not rely on tax-loss harvesting output without professional tax review.
Do not assume missing currency, frequency, date, or symbol values for DCA plans.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Longbridge account?
faq.answer: Yes. Most account, statement, position, order, and DCA workflows require Longbridge authentication and the correct permission scope.

faq.question: Can it place trades?
faq.answer: Yes, it can guide order and DCA mutations when permissions allow. It requires a preview and explicit user confirmation before execution.

faq.question: Is the portfolio analysis investment advice?
faq.answer: No. The analysis is informational and depends on Longbridge data. Users should make their own decisions or consult a professional.

faq.question: What data can it review?
faq.answer: It can review assets, cash, buying power, positions, P&L, cash flow, statements, bank cards, margin ratios, and DCA records.

faq.question: What languages does it support?
faq.answer: The skill instructs the assistant to respond in the user input language, including English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.

faq.question: Can it export statements?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide Longbridge statement listing and export workflows when account permissions and file keys are available.
